title: CartPole baselines aligned to the BART fidelity test split
finding: The BART run used a stratified split; the published notebook-protocol baselines used an unstratified split. Same sizes, different test rows. Aligned baselines below use the BART split exactly.
task: features at t (including action at t) -> action at t+1
